checked-read-profile.selection: checked SourceView execution contract; HTTP binding resolves http_read_transport, not SourceReadPlan

catalog-single-request.selection: checked Catalog member at SourceView.acquisition.request_schema; kind=request_schema

catalog-request.selection: single: acquisition.request_schema kind=request_schema; native: acquisition.batching.batch_request_schema kind=lookup_batch_request

catalog-response.selection: SourceView.output.schema kind=carrier_schema; extracted Relation row type, not raw HTTP wrapper

raw_response.bytes: content_cid hashes exact decoded bytes, not JSON reserialization

laws.cid: AoA computeCid of the complete closed body excluding only self_cid; validate incoming shape, ordering and references without normalization
laws.logical_value: computeCid({sort:"relation",value:canonical_rows}); ordered rows and multiplicity are semantic; exact captured bytes are a separate artifact
laws.key_set: ResourceRef cell is its identity_cid string; ArtifactRef cell is its artifact_ref_cid string; no object expansion or capability bytes; canonical role and typed tuple order after null exclusion and dedupe
laws.request: request_values must validate against the resolved closed request_schema_cid with unknown keys rejected; continuation.token must validate against transport_plan.pagination.token_contract; validate before hashing without coercion or repair
laws.catalog: schema slots hash the complete Catalog ContractEnvelope excluding only cid, including schema/id/version/kind/body; validate exact SourceView role, Catalog membership and ownership; body uses ActQL value contracts, not raw JSON Schema; transport mapping/extraction binds semantic input/output and no generated wire schema is mandatory
laws.lists: typed evidence references sort by kind then cid; CID sets lexically; scope sources by canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes; tuples by typed key order; reject duplicates and unsorted sealed bodies, never normalize incoming artifacts
laws.completeness: unknown acquisition completeness cannot become complete; publish Result partial or reject a consumer requiring complete coverage; keep original unknown evidence
laws.batch_plan: ordered partition of canonical key indices; every index exactly once; no runtime page tokens; repartition changes identity
laws.attempt_receipt: complete cumulative attempt table ordered by batch_index,page_index,network_attempt; immutable linked snapshots; real lifecycle evidence and no downstream relation/evidence/Invocation references
laws.attempt_transition: preserve slot/request/batch/page/network_attempt and known evidence; immutable prior snapshots do not prohibit authenticated dispatched/unknown settlement; exact matching event ancestry is required; captured payload and adoption cannot change
laws.accounting: receipt and accounting have exactly the same slot/attempt key set; measured decoded usage includes captured response bytes, wire usage is separately measured; usage_final requires completed measurement evidence, not an outcome name; reservation settlement validates event/capture/measurement correspondence
laws.relation: same envelope for input and validated output, checked by role; schema, logical order, scope, policy, retention and upstream provenance bind identity; no final Invocation or synthetic ResultDefinition
laws.closure: typed resolution, hash validation, semantic cross-binding, authority and availability are required; valid self hashes alone are not admission
laws.adoption: durably activate before dispatch; adopt once from the active captured attempt after logical page validation; continuation uses only the preceding adopted response and exact token; succeeded requires terminal adopted chains for every batch, except zero keys requires no calls
laws.success_seal: Lookup Evidence pins the immutable succeeded receipt and adopted pages; subsequent late capture or accounting snapshots cannot replace that receipt, validated Relation or Invocation
laws.reservations: obsolete unknown reads may coexist with success only under admitted finite retry and durable worst-case outstanding reservations; measured plus reserved usage fits every ceiling; release only against authenticated final accounting or charge the full reservation at its fixed deadline
laws.raw_response: self_cid hashes the closed metadata envelope; content_cid is sha256 of exact decoded response bytes, size_bytes their length; authenticated capture binds call slot, attempt, policy and retention before page admission; not a Result Artifact
laws.external_references: egress reuses SourceRequestEgressAdmission, hashing all fields except admission_cid; bind barrier,input,request egress requirements,Ref availability,authority and current Host policy before dispatch; transport adapter resolves the checked SourceView read execution contract (HTTP http_read_transport transport_cid), never SourceReadPlan; source witnesses resolve evidence_kinds.source; runtime errors resolve the pinned protocol runtime_error schema; traverse registered reference roles only, never CID-shaped business strings
